# Semigroup bound for a group generated by roots and a torus centralizer

This internal lemma bounds the range of any `IsRootSubsetGroup i S j` by the
actual semigroup subgroup for `(AddSubmonoid.closure S).toAddSubsemigroup`.
Its hypotheses retain a connected reductive group over a field, a maximal
split torus, a generic cocharacter, and the inclusion of `S` in the actual
relative roots. Closedness of `S` is not needed for this bound.

The published generic-centralizer theorem and dynamic-semigroup comparison
identify the torus centralizer with the zero-pairing semigroup subgroup.
On the ambient action weights, genericity makes every zero-pairing weight
zero. The generated additive monoid contains zero, so monotonicity on
ambient weights includes the centralizer in the desired semigroup group.
The cyclic-tail description of a relative root group includes every root
group indexed by `S` there as well.

The published semigroup-realization theorem supplies a closed represented
subgroup with this semigroup functor. The defining minimality of
`IsRootSubsetGroup` then gives the claimed range inclusion on every test
scheme. This lemma is derived from these published Library interfaces for
the proof of Borel–Tits 3.22 c); it is not a separate assertion from the
original literature.
